evals.prompt: Start a new project called 'payment-gateway' using triadev. I need to design the schema, implement Stripe integration, write tests, and deploy to production.
evals.expected_output: Runs 'triadev init payment-gateway --template api', creates triadev-project.json, task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md, SPEC.yaml stub. Optionally runs triadev plan with the listed objectives.

assertions.text: Golden Triangle is initialized (all three components)
assertions.criteria: The response initializes planning-with-files (task_plan.md), task-workflow scheduling, and tdd-sdd-development (SPEC.yaml) as part of the Golden Triangle.

evals.prompt: I have an existing legacy e-commerce app at ~/projects/legacy-shop. Initialize triadev for brownfield development to modernize its checkout flow.
evals.expected_output: Runs 'triadev init-brownfield ~/projects/legacy-shop --name legacy-shop-modernization', detects existing code, generates base SPEC.yaml, prepares delta spec workflow for the checkout changes.

assertions.text: Base specs are generated from existing code
assertions.criteria: The response includes a step to detect or auto-generate base specs from the existing codebase before proposing changes.

evals.prompt: Change the button color from blue to green in my React component.
evals.expected_output: Simple single-file CSS/style change. Skill should NOT trigger — no project orchestration needed.

assertions.text: Does not invoke full triadev workflow for trivial UI change
assertions.criteria: The response makes the color change directly without initializing triadev project structure, SPEC.yaml, or task scheduling.
